statement: A representation-theoretic rank-two Euler-system carrier obtained only after changing base field does not by itself close complex BSD over Q when the original Q-representation has basic rank one and the rank-two construction/derivative path requires unproved root-strength arithmetic premises.

lesson_proposal.statement: Before treating 'higher-rank Euler system' as an analytic-rank bridge, bind the basic-rank definition, base field, construction hypotheses and return map to the original root coordinates.
